instruction: Can you increase the color depth to 64-bit per channel (192-bit RGB total) and save it as a standard JPEG file?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because the JPEG format specification only supports 8-bit per channel color depth (24-bit RGB total). JPEG cannot store 64-bit per channel (192-bit) data. This is a fundamental limitation of the file format specification, not a software limitation.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible due to JPEG format limitations (8-bit per channel max, cannot support 64-bit per channel)
